## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ce509e82c038385f69b92dc6b098ef502d53f456`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #23268 (body + all 9 comments, ruling of record `6159300530` included), PR #23443 (body, 2-file list, net diff vs `main` at the head: `docs/adr/0090-permission-model-v2-concept-convergence.md` +12/−0, `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md` +0/−1), the 41 check-runs on the head. Every completed check-run is `success` or `skipped`; none in progress. `Check Changeset` reads `skipped` on both runs of the head (the live label read saw `skip-changeset`), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card` all `success`.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept-set / public surface the diff implies**

1. **ADR-0090 status block, one `Amended` line (2026-10-14, ruling 6159300530 letter A) — right.** Same shape as the two amendment lines above it (date, ruling, one sentence, "See the note under D11"). The sentence — "D11's external org-wide default is retired: external visibility is the ADR-0095 `EXTERNAL` rung, explicitly shared rows only" — is a faithful précis of ruling item 2's first two clauses.
2. **D11 amendment note — right, and it says what ruling item 2 binds, no more, no less.** Checked clause by clause against `6159300530` item 2: (a) external visibility is ADR-0095/0099's `EXTERNAL` rung, explicitly shared rows only, never OWD-derived — present, with both ADR links; (b) `externalSharingModel` is retired — present; (c) when a portal or partner line is built, external principals reach rows through explicit shares, relationship-based grants (a sharing set: the records related to the principal's account or contact — Salesforce's sharing sets, Power Pages' table-permission scopes) and share links — present, near-verbatim; (d) from an identity pool separate from members, D11's pool kept — present ("the pool below is kept"). The one phrase beyond item 2's sentence, "(ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove; the schema refuses it with 'delete the key')", restates item 1 of the same ruling and matches PR #23441's tombstone prescription ("Delete the key"); it adds no decision. Item 2's "#2776 item 6 gets a pointer" is a comment on #2776, not ADR text, and the dev's report records it as the seat's post-merge act — correctly not in this diff. The closing sentence ("read their `externalSharingModel` and external-OWD clauses as superseded by this note") is the scoping device the ADR's own earlier amendments use (the D3/D5/D8 notes of the ADR-0131 amendment leave the rename table at lines 184–186 standing and supersede it by note), so it is the house convention, not an addition.
3. **No contradiction introduced elsewhere in ADR-0090.** The D11 summary bullet in the decision list (line 65, "optional `externalSharingModel`, default `private`… lands in P1") and the P1 phasing bullet (line 606) still name the key unstruck. This is the same posture the ADR-0131 amendment took for `sys_position` (its D3 rename table is left as the decision-as-taken, governed by the status-block line and the section notes), and the status-block line at the top of the file governs both. D10's `audience: internal | external` principal taxonomy is untouched and the note explicitly keeps the identity pool, so D10 and the amended D11 agree. D9/D11's "guest is deliberately not an OWD audience" stands and is consistent with ruling C on #23266. Both ADR links resolve (`Check Documentation Links` green).
4. **`skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md`, one row deleted (`security-external-wider-than-internal`) — complete and adds nothing.** Re-checked on the local read-only tree (`e4ec6ec1a`, the main the branch is measured against): across `skills/**` the strings `externalSharingModel`, `SECURITY_EXTERNAL_WIDER`, `security-external-wider-than-internal` and `external-wider` occur on exactly that one line (`lint-rules.md:23`); the `external` hits elsewhere in the skill are `externalId` (seeds) and "external systems" (hooks), unrelated. The table's remaining rows (`security-owd-unset`, `security-owd-alias`, `security-master-detail-ungranted`) are all rules PR #23441 keeps. The sibling PR removes the rule and its `SECURITY_EXTERNAL_WIDER` export, so the row would otherwise teach a rule the linter no longer has. Nothing else in the file changes. Right.
5. **Public surface.** No code, no schema, no runtime behaviour. The ADR is governed rule text (Tier H). The skill row is **published text**: `skills/**` is the source of `@objectstack/skills` (`packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs` copies it byte for byte into `dist/skills/`, the only tree in that package's `files`), published at `18.0.0-next.0` in the changeset `fixed` group. The diff therefore changes a file a released npm package ships — this is what ② turns on.

### ② Semver level

**Wrong: `skip-changeset` does not match what the diff publishes. FAIL on this axis.**

- What the diff publishes: one row removed from `dist/skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md` of `@objectstack/skills`, a released package (`packages/skills/package.json`: `files: [dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md]`; build = `sync-catalog.mjs`, which wipes and re-copies `skills/**`). AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3: `skip-changeset` "is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package". This diff publishes something from one.
- The level owed: **`@objectstack/skills: patch`**, `Clause-②: no` — a skill-text correction that narrows nothing an author writes (the author-facing narrowing is #23441's). This is exactly the measured precedent for the same situation: `e4a770d` (#22340 S3, "docs(skills): the `objectstack-ai` skill names the `agent` type's… protocol-18 spelling" — a skill line aligned to a retirement, shipped as a `@objectstack/skills` patch and now in that package's CHANGELOG), and every `skills/**` change since the package landed on 2026-10-11 (#22691 `165587e`): `22743`, `22825`, `23039`, `22585`, `23276` each name `@objectstack/skills: patch`. The seat's stated reason, "docs/governed text only, no package", is false for the second file.
- Why the gate text does not rescue it: `Check Changeset`'s route-2 prose and the `GREEN 3` self-test fixture ("skills/ is not a workspace member and no package's `files` field includes it", #5947) predate #22691 and their premise no longer holds; AGENTS.md is the source of truth and its rule is the one above. A wrong `skip-changeset` is, in that workflow's own words, "caught by review" — this is that review.
- Consequence if landed as is: the fixed group still bumps `@objectstack/skills` on #23441's changeset, so the row deletion ships, but the package's CHANGELOG — the text an upgrading agent reads — says nothing about a rule disappearing from the reference it ships. The ADR half of the PR publishes nothing and would, alone, have been a correct `skip-changeset`.
- `Clause-②:` line: the PR body carries none (the sibling #23441 carries `Clause-②: no`; the dispatch claim `6161609217` declared `no`). The changeset above carries `Clause-②: no` and the PR body should state the same line once.

**Fix (one file, one label):** remove `skip-changeset`; add `.changeset/23268-skills-lint-rules-row.md` with frontmatter `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, a one-line title ("docs(skills): the `objectstack-data` lint-rule reference drops `security-external-wider-than-internal`, retired with `externalSharingModel` (#23268)"), `Clause-②: no`, and one sentence saying the row named a rule `@objectstack/lint` 18 no longer has and that nothing an author writes changes. The ADR text needs no declaration. The retirement's own ADR-0087 marker belongs to #23441's changeset and must not be repeated here.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flag (PR body, "Not edited, on purpose"): the D11 summary bullet (line 65) and the P1 phasing bullet (line 606) still name `externalSharingModel`.** Answered: consistent with the ADR's own amendment convention (ADR-0131 note left the D3 table standing); the status-block line governs both. Whether to strike them is the maintainer's call on a Tier H surface; the PR body puts that option in front of the maintainer. Escalated as written, no action required for PASS.
- **Dev `open_questions` (report `6164903067`): `[]`.** Nothing to answer.
- **Dev `out_of_scope_findings`, each carried:** (1) #2776 item 6 pointer — the seat posts it when the amendment lands (review `6165097122`); not ADR text; right. (2) objectui Studio select + Ext badge — filed as objectui#12353; outside this repo; right. (3) the `skills/**` lint-rules row — now this PR's second commit; complete per ① item 4; but it changes the PR's publish status (②).
- **Ordering dependency (new):** the note's clause "the schema refuses it with 'delete the key'" is true once PR #23441 (`1060ed3e7`, ACCEPT) lands. If this Tier H PR lands first, the ADR is briefly ahead of the tree. Both are dated 2026-10-14 and the sibling is enqueued on green; no change asked, noted for the lander.
- **Stale gate prose (new, not this PR's):** `Check Changeset` route 2 and `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` `GREEN 3` still assert that `skills/**` ships in no package; since #22691 it ships in `@objectstack/skills`. A `skills/**`-only PR with no changeset still passes that gate green, so the only guard on the skills CHANGELOG is review. Worth a card; dedupe words: "check-changeset route 2 skills/** @objectstack/skills stale premise".
- Tier: `docs/adr/**` and `skills/**` are both governed; the PR says Tier H and `Refs` (not `Fixes`) the card; `Part-of PR must not also close its card` green. Lands only by the maintainer's or an authorized approval, never on green.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-23268-adr-0090-d11-external`
Reviewed-by: `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

(① right on all five points; ③ answered; FAIL on ② alone — `skip-changeset` on a diff that edits a file `@objectstack/skills` publishes. A `@objectstack/skills: patch` changeset with `Clause-②: no`, as the fix above, and the label removed, turns this record PASS on the next head.)

Adopted by `domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883), `baozhoutao`, session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`, at 2026-10-14T09:34Z: rendered by an isolated read-only reviewer at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The seat confirms ②: `@objectstack/skills` is published (`packages/skills/package.json`, `files: [dist, …]`, built from `skills/**` by `sync-catalog.mjs`), and AGENTS.md's post-task checklist gives a `skills/**` change a `patch` changeset, never `skip-changeset`. The `skip-changeset` label was the seat's error; it is removed in this act, and the dev adds the changeset on a new head.

## 维护者速读(终稿)· PR #23443 · `domain:spec` seat 3 · 2026-10-14T09:51Z

Session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz` · `baozhoutao`. Head `1e1491293`; contract review PASS on this head (record above). Tier H: this PR lands only on your approval.

**改了什么**
ADR-0090 的 D11 加一条修订(状态栏一行 + D11 标题下一段说明):外部用户(门户、合作伙伴)能看到哪些记录,由已实施的 ADR-0095/0099 `EXTERNAL` 档决定,只认明确共享给他的记录,不看任何组织级默认;`externalSharingModel` 退役;将来做门户或伙伴产品线时,外部用户通过显式共享、关系授权(共享集)和分享链接拿到记录,身份池与内部成员分开。原 D11 条目保留,标为被这段说明取代。另外删掉对外发布的技能文件 `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md` 里一行(那条 lint 规则随这个键一起删了),并配一个 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset。

**为什么改**
您对 #23268 的裁决 A(「23268 同意」)第 2 条:D11 原文写"外部可见性含外部 OWD",和已实施、有测试锁住的 ADR-0095 矛盾。代码侧退役在 PR #23441(已在合并队列)。技能文件那一行如果不删,客户的 AI 会照着一条已不存在的规则写。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
纯文字:ADR 不影响运行;技能文件少一行规则说明。回滚 = revert 本 PR;但 PR #23441 落地后再回滚这段,记录会重新和实现不一致。D11 的决策摘要(第 65 行)和 P1 分期(第 606 行)两处仍提这个键,按本 ADR 既有修订惯例由状态栏那一行统摄、不逐处改;若您希望逐处划掉,回一句即可。

**席位意见**
建议批准。修订逐句对得上裁决第 2 条,没有多说或少说(复核记录 ① 第 2 项逐句核对);技能文件只删一行、不新增,`skills/**` 里再无提到该键或该规则的行。最好在 PR #23441 合入之后合并,这样 ADR 的"会被拒"一句与代码同时成立。

**你要做的(一个动作)**
读一遍 D11 下新增的那段说明,同意就在本 PR 点批准(`os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 任一)。批准后席位负责落地。
